title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out and about with Hishi Akebono…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Awww! ♪ Those plushies are sooo cute!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's see… It says they're called "Cuties"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look where Hishi Akebono is pointing and see a claw machine filled with Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I bet it'd be really fun to win a bunch and then surround myself with them! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I could cuddle them in bed when it's cold, and chat with them when I'm bored… How buono! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The only thing is, I'm really bad with claw machines.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I always try to go for the big prizes, but I can never get them…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Really? You will? That'd be super buono! I'll cheer you on, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
